papers.title: Investigation of the accuracy and roughness in the laser powder bed fusion process
papers.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) process has had a rapid growth in the industrial fields because of the capability to manufacture metallic complex shapes. The purpose of this study is to investigate the accuracy and surface roughness of parts manufactured by L-PBF in the AlSi10Mg alloy. The results showed that the choice of parameters of conversion from the CAD model to STL file and the setting of process parameters can affect the accuracy. In the L-PBF process, the staircase effect, inherent in additive manufacturing technologies due to the layered nature of the process, is not visible due to the melting of thin layers of metal powder. The surface roughness is mainly caused by the process parameters, orientation and position of the part with respect to the recoating blade and by the presence of partially fused particles that adhere to the molten part.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究通用LPBF工艺的精度和粗糙度，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or any biomedical context for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光粉末床熔融工艺的精度和表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验分析工艺参数对AlSi10Mg合金零件精度和粗糙度的影响。
summary_zh.result: CAD到STL转换参数和工艺参数影响精度，表面粗糙度主要由工艺参数和部分熔融颗粒导致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量和对比分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the accuracy and surface roughness of parts manufactured by laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Experimental analysis of the effects of process parameters on dimensional accuracy and surface roughness of AlSi10Mg alloy parts.
summary_en.result: The conversion parameters from CAD to STL and process parameters affect accuracy, while surface roughness is primarily caused by process parameters and partially fused particles.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of surface roughness and accuracy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文报告了定制非骨水泥柄在髋关节融合术中的长期临床结果，但未涉及任何生物力学分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the long-term clinical outcomes of custom cementless stems in total hip arthroplasty performed after hip fusion.
summary_en.method: A retrospective follow-up study of patients who received custom stems, assessing implant survival and complications.
summary_en.result: Implant survival and complication rates were reported.
